title: Login Success Redirect to Dashboard
description: Ensure that after a successful login or social authentication, the user is redirected to the Dashboard page. Handle redirections for cases where a user attempted to access a protected route without being authenticated.
requirements: Redirect to '/' after social login callback.
Support 'redirect_uri' parameter for deep linking after login.
implementation_notes: The current `LoginPage.tsx` and `AuthCallbackPage.tsx` already navigate to '/'. This ticket ensures consistency and handles the deep link parameter if needed.
